meaning:
A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.1.2; married to Elkanah (H0511H)
§ Peninnah = "jewel"
the other wife of Elkanah besides Hannah

elsewhere.note: He had two wives. The name of one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.
